sql: /* Query 8: filter4_join2 (player, team, city, manager) */ SELECT player.nationality, manager.nationality, city.population, team.championship FROM player JOIN team ON player.team = team.team_name JOIN manager ON team.ownership = manager.name JOIN city ON team.location = city.city_name WHERE player.position <> 'Backcourt' AND player.draft_year >= 2005 AND city.city_name <> 'Minneapolis'

nationality.description: nationality of the player (e.g., American, France).
nationality is the nationality of the team owner (e.g. American).

population.description: population is the population of the city (e.g. 7000000).

championship.description: championships is the number of this team getting championships (e.g. 5).
